title: Legion of Apocalypse
wikitext:
One of the earliest QuakeWorld clans in Poland. Founded in Jastrzebie Zdroj by [[Luc]], [[Loki]], Zajcew([[Gawlo]]) and [[Ropo]]. LoA was a HPB clan, all members had only a modem access to the Internet. However they were on Myslowice 3rd Lan Party (Zajcev and [[Loki]]) and also on 4th edition of this event ([[Zajcew]], [[Loki]], [[Ropo]], [[Luc]]) where they've played many games with clans like [[Bad Boys]] and [[Hard Guns Crew]].
